pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: In the interest of providing a pathway for teacher leadership as well as support for selected school sites, the District and the Union agree to establish a Master Teacher program of up to fifty (50) teachers. Teachers designated as Master Teachers shall receive additional compensation in the amount of Two Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($2,500.00) annually and shall be provided with 0.2 FTE release time to assist other teachers at their schools or other District-designated sites.
